name: The Ghost Production: Tech House
_source: Checked 2026-10-30 against theghostproduction.com/how-to-upload-tracks. Platform rules change: check them before each submission and edit this file.

stems._count_note: TGP sets no minimum stem count, only 'labeled by instrument'. 10 is the Cryx standard; lower it here if a track really has fewer parts.

mix._note: Unmastered mixdown: at least -3 dB headroom, no limiter or compression on the master. TGP gives no lower limit.

null_test._note: Starting thresholds. Tune on the first real exports.

master._lufs_note: TGP's upload page sets no LUFS range, so loudness is only measured and noted.
master._peak_note: Master must not exceed 0 dBFS: leave at least 0.1 dB headroom.
master._length_note: Extended mix 4:00 to 8:00, radio edit 2:00 to 3:00.

mixes._note: Extended mix and radio edit are optional but recommended on TGP.

checklist: Zip is named Track_Name.zip with folders Mastered, Unmastered, Stems, MIDI (and DAW_Project if you sell it).
Unmastered mixdown WAV goes in the Unmastered folder (the bot's Main.wav), no limiter or compression on the master.
MIDI files for all melodic and harmonic parts (Track_Name_Lead.mid, Track_Name_Chords.mid).
Vocals in the track? Add an Instrumental (WAV + MP3) and pick the vocal type: Royalty-Free (with source link), Exclusive or AI Vocal (tool name + URL).
Melodic third-party samples used? Pick instrumental type Semi-Original, not Original.
Selling the project? Full DAW project package with every sample and asset, so it opens with nothing missing.
Artwork: JPG, square 1:1, at least 500x500 px, RGB, no artist or label names, no watermarked stock photos.
Track info: title, genre, exact BPM, key, description, DAW + version, OS + version, third-party plugins used.
Title has no artist, DJ, label or trademark names.
